Build an FLom operating model from an FLa4a stock assessment fit

Source: R/om.R
asFLom.Rd

Converts an a4aFitSA stock assessment fit into an FLom operating model. Simulation draws from the fit are added to the input FLStock, stk, a stock-recruitment relationship is fitted (jointly across iterations, or to the iteration's median, depending on sa2sr), and reference points are calculated with FLBRP() and remapped to Blim, Bsafe, FMSY, SBMSY, BMSY, B0, and SB0. The resulting FLom is then extended to fy with fwdWindow(). The method:

  • Simulates stock trajectories from the assessment fit

  • Updates the stock with simulated values

  • Fits a stock-recruitment relationship using FLSR and fmle

  • Generates autocorrelated lognormal S/R deviances for projection

  • Calculates biological reference points using FLBRP

  • Maps reference points to standard names (Blim, Bsafe, FMSY, etc.)

  • Extends the operating model to the final year using fwdWindow

This method requires the FLa4a package.

asFLom(object, stk, sr_model, fy, it=1, nsq=3, sa2sr=TRUE,
  refpts=list(bsafe = "spr.40", blim = "spr.20", fmsy = "f0.1"), ...)

Arguments

object

An a4aFitSA stock assessment fit.

stk

The FLStock associated with object, updated with the simulated variability from the fit.

sr_model

Stock-recruitment model to fit, as accepted by as.FLSR().

fy

Final year to extend the operating model to.

it

Number of simulations to draw from object. Defaults to 1.

nsq

Number of years to average over when extending the stock, passed to fwdWindow(). Defaults to 3.

sa2sr

If TRUE (default), the stock-recruitment model is fitted using all iterations of stk. If FALSE, it is fitted to the iteration medians instead.

refpts

A named list identifying, by name, the FLBRP reference points to use as Bsafe, Blim, and FMSY.

...

Additional arguments passed to fwdWindow().

Value

An object of class FLom.
